id: 06_Other General Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 6
title: 实验室安全（六）：其他常见危害
source_doc: course/Chemical Spillage & Response/06_Other General Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 6.md
author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/06_Other General Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 6/src.py

points.K1: 还有几类危害同样重要
points.K4: 通电时不维修、不开外壳
points.K5: 常查电线，用合格插线板
points.K10: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免
points.K19: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室里，张开双手对镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the lab and opens both arms toward the camera.
shots.narration: 安全系列最后一课：其他常见危害。
overlay: 实验室的其他常见危害

shots.scene: 电插头、热表面、雪花、滑倒小人、气瓶五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: an electric plug with a lightning bolt, a hot surface, a snowflake, a slipping person pictogram and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 触电、烫伤、冻伤、摔跤和气瓶。

shots.scene: 阿杰拎着两桶液体进门，把桶放在地上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries two jugs of liquid into the lab and sets them down on the floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰拎着两桶液体走进实验室。

shots.scene: 小研抱着一摞空白文件走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over carrying a stack of blank folders.
shots.narration: 这些日常小事里，也藏着危害。

shots.section_title: 还有几类危害同样重要
shots.scene: 小研扣实验服、墙上挂着灭火器、倒试剂三个回顾小画面
shots.prompt_en: Three small recap panels: the female graduate student buttoning a lab coat, a fire extinguisher with an inspection tag, and acid being poured into a beaker. No faces.
shots.narration: 前几课讲了着装、防护、设施和行为。
overlay: 还有几类危害同样重要

shots.section_title: 还有几类危害同样重要
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 还有化学品安全；另外几类也很重要。

shots.scene: 仪器上方亮起闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a yellow electrical hazard lightning bolt icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 先说触电。

shots.scene: 老周往自动进样器里放样品瓶，旁边是落地离心机
shots.prompt_en: The older man loads sample vials into an autosampler next to a floor-standing centrifuge.
shots.narration: 很多设备都在很高的电压下运行。

shots.scene: 一只装水的烧杯紧挨着离心机电源线
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of water sits right next to the power cord of a centrifuge on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 让水和各种液体远离仪器。

shots.section_title: 通电时不维修、不开外壳
shots.scene: 手按下仪器开关，机身贴着一块空白警示标签
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses the power switch of an instrument that has a blank warning label on its housing. No faces.
shots.narration: 仪器插着电时，
overlay: 通电时不维修、不开外壳

shots.section_title: 通电时不维修、不开外壳
shots.scene: 插着电打开仪器外壳的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a screwdriver opening the cover of a plugged-in instrument, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要维修，也不要打开任何外壳。

shots.section_title: 常查电线，用合格插线板
shots.scene: 小研检查显微镜的电源线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the power cord of a microscope at her bench.
shots.narration: 定期检查设备，看电线有没有磨损。
overlay: 常查电线，用合格插线板

shots.section_title: 常查电线，用合格插线板
shots.scene: 插线板上缠成一团的电源线被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A power strip with a tangled mass of cords plugged into it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只用合格的延长线和插线板。

shots.scene: 戴黄色隔热手套拧开台式灭菌锅的盖子，提出网篮
shots.prompt_en: Hands in yellow heat-resistant gloves unscrew the lid of a benchtop autoclave and lift out a wire basket. No faces.
shots.narration: 灭菌锅这类仪器温度很高，会烫伤人。

shots.scene: 小研戴上耐热手套，取出热的网篮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on heat-resistant gloves and lifts a hot wire basket.
shots.narration: 取放热的东西，一定戴耐热手套。

shots.scene: 阿杰在气相色谱-质谱仪前更换样品
shots.prompt_en: The young male student changes a sample at a gas chromatograph mass spectrometer.
shots.narration: 用气相色谱-质谱这类加热仪器，

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上的温度设定值往下调，旁边的温箱门打开
shots.prompt_en: On a computer screen a temperature set point bar is lowered, then the column oven door of the instrument opens to show a coiled column. No people.
shots.narration: 先调低温度设定，再打开盖子。

shots.scene: 手戴上蓝色长款低温手套
shots.prompt_en: A hand pulls on a long blue insulated cryogenic glove. No faces.
shots.narration: 极低的温度，也会伤到裸露的皮肤。

shots.scene: 戴低温手套的手打开超低温冰箱门
shots.prompt_en: A hand in an insulated glove opens the door of an ultra-low freezer. No faces.
shots.narration: 拿干冰和零下80度冰箱里的东西，

shots.scene: 干冰块和雪花图标旁，隔热手套打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of dry ice blocks and a snowflake next to an insulated glove with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 要戴隔热手套。

shots.section_title: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，身旁出现滑倒小人图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera next to a slipping person pictogram.
shots.narration: 滑倒、绊倒和跌落会造成重伤，
overlay: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免

shots.section_title: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免
shots.scene: 地上一团湿纸巾，一只脚踩过
shots.prompt_en: A wet paper towel on the lab floor as a foot steps on it. No faces.
shots.narration: 但大多数都可以避免。

shots.scene: 小研把椅子推进台下，通道变得畅通
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pushes a chair under the bench, leaving the aisle clear.
shots.narration: 地面和通道，不留任何障碍物。

shots.scene: 小研拎着两桶液体，把桶放在地上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries two jugs of liquid and sets them down on the floor.
shots.narration: 任何材料和仪器都不要放在地上，

shots.scene: 小研把桶提起来放回台下的架子上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the jugs and puts them on a shelf under the bench.
shots.narration: 临时放一下也不行。

shots.scene: 黄色小心地滑提示牌立在拖把和水桶旁
shots.prompt_en: A yellow wet floor caution sign stands next to a mop and bucket. No people.
shots.narration: 溅洒立即清理，放提示牌提醒同事。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，指向头顶的架子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera and points up at a shelf above its head.
shots.narration: 留意周围的环境。

shots.scene: 阿杰从低矮的台架下起身，小心避开架子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands up carefully from under a low bench shelf, avoiding hitting his head.
shots.narration: 小心架子、台面，别碰到头。

shots.scene: 气瓶标签上的菱形标签特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gas cylinder with a diamond-shaped hazard label and a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩气瓶里的压力极高。

shots.scene: 气瓶瓶头断裂后飞出的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas cylinder with a broken valve shooting forward like a rocket. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶一旦受损，可能高速飞出。

shots.scene: 绿色气瓶上的易燃气体菱形标签
shots.prompt_en: A green gas cylinder with a red flammable gas diamond label. No people.
shots.narration: 有的气体，比如氢气，还极易燃。

shots.scene: 老李用绑带把气瓶固定在实验台边
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer secures a gas cylinder to the side of a lab bench with a strap.
shots.narration: 用结实的夹具和绑带固定气瓶。

shots.scene: 绑带卡扣扣紧的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a strap buckle being clicked tight around a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 扣紧，别让它倒下。

shots.scene: 手把保护帽拧到瓶头上
shots.prompt_en: A hand screws a protective cap onto the top of a gas cylinder. No faces.
shots.narration: 气瓶不用时，拧上螺纹保护帽。

shots.section_title: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜讲解，中景
shots.prompt_en: A medium shot of the panda mascot talking to the camera.
shots.narration: 实验室事故大多是轻微的。
overlay: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少

shots.section_title: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少
shots.scene: 忘记的规程图标：一本合上的手册和问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a closed procedure manual with a question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 多是因为忽视或忘了安全规程。

shots.section_title: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少
shots.scene: 警示三角图标变大，旁边一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon grows larger, then a shield icon appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 严重甚至致命的事故也确实会发生。

shots.section_title: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少
shots.scene: 欣欣近景，点头
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the panda mascot nodding.
shots.narration: 遵守安全规则，大小事故都会减少。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在台前一起操作，互相看一眼
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work together at a bench and glance at each other.
shots.narration: 也要留意同事，确保他们安全工作。

shots.scene: 欣欣近景，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the panda mascot giving a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 好的科学，始于安全的科学。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves warmly.
shots.narration: 注意安全，保重。

shots.scene: 插头、热表面、雪花图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electric plug, a hot surface and a snowflake. No people.
shots.narration: 液体远离仪器，冷热都戴手套。

shots.scene: 畅通通道和小心地滑提示牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clear aisle and a wet floor caution sign. No people.
shots.narration: 通道畅通，地上不放东西。

shots.scene: 固定好的气瓶和保护帽图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a strapped gas cylinder with a protective cap. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定牢，不用拧好帽。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 安全做科学，我们下次见！
